<!-- Generated by internal/tools/docgen from the cobra command tree. DO NOT EDIT: run `make docs-reference`. -->

An interactive prompt for iterative log investigation: type a WHERE expression to run
it, refine, rerun. Meta-commands (\\help lists them) switch dataset and window, page
through results, or drop into a live tail. History persists across sessions.

```sh
bronto repl [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--dataset` | `-d` | stringArray |  | dataset name or UUID to query (repeatable) |
| `--from-expr` |  | string |  | dataset selector expression |
| `--since` |  | string |  | initial lookback window (default 15m) |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

#### Examples

```sh
bronto repl -d payments-api
bronto repl -d payments-api --since 1h
```
